names.name: Mister Donut
names.said: Gone in America, enormous in Japan.

text.what: The chain founded by Harry Winokur, Bill Rosenberg's former partner, absorbed into Dunkin' in the United States and still large in Asia.
text.story: Dunkin's parent bought Mister Donut in 1990 and converted the American shops. In 2003 the Japanese Mister Donut launched pon de ring, the eight-ball chewy donut named after Brazilian pão de queijo, which travelled to Hawaii and then to the mainland as the mochi donut.
text.today: The American chain disappeared into its rival; the Japanese one exported a new shape back.

kin.as: The shape its Japanese arm launched.
The chain that carried the shape into American strip malls.
